programme.interpretation: Cumulative alpha over every test in every campaign IS the expected number of false findings for the whole programme. Compare it to the finding count. A campaign is never re-run against a hypothesis it has already tested, which is what stops the count from being shopped.

summary.note: A low acceptance rate is the expected outcome. This project has falsified eleven method families; the gate refusing is the gate working.
